title: Escape must close the suggestion list without erasing what the user typed
status: Open. The maintainer tracks the change for v11 in issue #485; no fix is merged at pinnedCommit (the current head).
summary: Pressing Escape to dismiss suggestions sets the input value to an empty string, so a user editing a saved field loses their text.
expectedBehaviour: As proposed by the maintainer in #485: Escape closes the list only and keeps the input. The reporter of #402 suggested restoring the earlier value instead; this task follows the maintainer's plan.
consumer: Author-written delivery profile form around the unchanged upstream ES module source at pinnedCommit; an import map resolves its extensionless imports.
